title: FileStorage::read unbounded read_to_end amplifies planted oversized records to OOM
description: lichen-hal/src/storage.rs fs::FileStorage::read (~line 529) does read_to_end into an unbounded Vec before copying min(stored, buf.len()). Callers pass small buffers (announce store: 82 bytes) but the allocation is file-sized; a planted multi-GB file at any record key turns load() into unbounded allocation instead of Err(Corrupt). Newly reachable via rust/lichen-node/src/announce_store.rs load(); gateway stores share the exposure (pre-existing). Fix: pre-stat the file and cap the read at buf.len()+1, rejecting anything larger. Found by security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-12zy.
